# Key Findings (auto-generated)

Factual rollup of the current feature dataset. Interpretation lives in the final report.

## Overview
- Posts: 73,689 across 2 platforms (youtube: 63,454, instagram: 10,235).
- Content date range: 2016-04-20 to 2026-11-15.

## Sentiment by platform (English)
- instagram: positive 84.9%, neutral 7.4%, negative 7.7%.
- youtube: positive 60.5%, neutral 22.3%, negative 17.2%.

## Engagement vs sentiment
- Avg engagement percentile by sentiment: negative 0.487, neutral 0.495, positive 0.505 (spread 0.018).
- Relationship is essentially flat (sentiment does not predict engagement).

## Dominant topics (by volume)
- T4: time, agent, new, think - 44,687 posts.
- T0: business, help, build, right - 10,358 posts.
- T3: course, hi, complete, youtube - 2,203 posts.
- T5: chat, gpt, chat gpt, claude - 1,584 posts.
- T2: free, free praise, praise, paid - 1,564 posts.

## Emerging vs declining topics (recent vs earlier in window)
- Rising: T0: business, help, build, right (+2.29 pts).
- Rising: T3: course, hi, complete, youtube (+0.2 pts).
- Rising: T2: free, free praise, praise, paid (-0.08 pts).
- Declining: T4: time, agent, new, think (-0.63 pts).
- Declining: T5: chat, gpt, chat gpt, claude (-1.05 pts).

## Top keywords (by volume)
- ChatGPT - 15,079 posts.
- AI Agents - 12,635 posts.
- Automation - 7,593 posts.
- Startup - 6,608 posts.
- SEO - 5,385 posts.

## Models
- Production sentiment model: vader (deploy-domain macro-F1 0.6493).
- Topic model: NMF, k=7, UMass coherence -0.8571 (more coherent than LDA).
